svg.title: HCSD proof plan: six falsifiable claims and their tests
svg.desc: Six claims arranged in two columns, each with a test and pass/fail criterion, connected to a shared infrastructure row at the bottom
svg.text: six falsifiable claims · each independently testable · fail one = revise that layer only

g.onclick: sendPrompt('In HCSD proof plan: explain claim 1 near-orthogonality in detail. What does the test measure, what is the expected distribution, and what would falsification look like?')
g.text: 1000 random sparse vecs · all pairwise cos

g.onclick: sendPrompt('In HCSD proof plan: explain claim 2 binding roundtrip in detail. How is circular convolution tested, what is the expected cosine after unbinding, and what load factors break it?')
g.text: a ⊛ b then a⁻¹ ⊛ result · cosine vs target

g.onclick: sendPrompt('In HCSD proof plan: explain claim 3 superposition capacity. How many pointer-value pairs can be stored in holographic memory M before deref precision drops below 95 percent?')
g.text: M = Σ pᵢ⊛vᵢ · deref precision vs load

g.onclick: sendPrompt('In HCSD proof plan: explain claim 4 dual space retrieval. How is the scene s = Σ vᵢ probed by dual vectors, what is the F1 score at varying scene sizes, and at what size does it collapse?')
g.text: scene s = Σ vᵢ · probe with v_C* · F1@1

g.onclick: sendPrompt('In HCSD proof plan: explain claim 5 CTE dict stack scoping in detail. Show the exact SQL for the bank disambiguation experiment and what the expected query results are in each frame context.')
g.text: "bank" in finance frame vs default frame

g.onclick: sendPrompt('In HCSD proof plan: explain claim 6 fractal hierarchy sparsity. How does the sparsity ratio change from L0 to L3, and where does it exceed the interference threshold?')
g.text: sparsity ρ(k) at L0 → L3 · cutoff validation

svg.text: pass: ρ < 2% at L2 with top-k projection

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the hcsd-vsa.ts file: sparse vector type, circular convolution, unbind, superpose, cosine similarity, and random atom generation')
sendPrompt('Explain the hcsd-schema.sql file: sparse concept store, quality atoms, concept refs, CTE dict stack lookup function, and recursive CTE for fractal hierarchy')
sendPrompt('Explain the hcsd-experiments.ts file: what each of the 6 experiments does, what it outputs, and how to interpret the results table')
sendPrompt('Explain the hcsd-example.ts file: the bank disambiguation end-to-end demo, the fractal hierarchy construction demo, and the holographic memory reference demo')
